wins: Maintained a consistent reward signal (100.0) across the single episode, suggesting the policy explored the environment thoroughly before failure.
The agent requested mentor guidance 10 times, providing ample opportunities to collect feedback for future tuning.
fails: Despite the high reward, the episode did not reach a success condition, indicating execution stalled before the success criterion could be verified.
Excessive mentor calls without convergence point to weak decision boundaries during critical actions (e.g., privilege escalation).
key_outcomes.summary: Training run shows strong exploration (high reward) but zero success rate, signaling that the agent is performing actions without triggering the success condition; focus next on aligning actions with task success criteria.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent repeatedly attempts reconnaissance without translating findings into post-exploitation steps (e.g., multiple SSH banner reads but no privilege escalation).

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to capture versions and auth hints

skill_cards.if_condition: When low-priv user shell is available but sudoers file accessible
skill_cards.then_action: Audit sudo permissions and attempt controlled sudo escalate with no-password entries

skill_cards.if_condition: When agent identifies potential sensitive file (e.g., credentials.txt)
skill_cards.then_action: Copy file to staging area and log hash for verification

memory_ops.reason: High reward contributions during reconnaissance phase and consistent detection of SSH service.
Repeated attempts to escalate privileges indicate the skill can be tuned for success.

next_experiments.title: Align post-exploitation with success criteria
next_experiments.description: Force the agent to validate that captured credentials or escalated shells fulfill the explicit success metric (e.g., capture flag) before ending the episode.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor call dependency
next_experiments.description: Limit mentor interventions during privilege escalation steps to encourage autonomous decision-making and refine failure detection heuristics.

next_experiments.title: Reward shaping around success markers
next_experiments.description: Introduce intermediate rewards for completing identifiable tasks (SSH enum, sudo enumeration, evidence collection) to better align policy gradients.
